_note: Verdicts on blocked symbols, so each is judged once. `triage.py` ranks
candidates; a person or an agent decides, and the decision lands here.
mis-marked  the facility exists; the row needs re-pointing or writing
probable    a candidate that looks right and was not run down
real        the gap is real, whatever the ranking suggested
A symbol absent from this file has not been judged. Recording `real` is
as valuable as recording `mis-marked`: it stops the next pass paying to

c.cover_from().why: f1296 says 'nothing asks what cover a creature has'. query.cover_between traces it corner to corner at the moment of the attack, and _covering already asks which creature is giving it. What is missing is a Cast door, not a mechanism.

c.aura(difficult=).why: The helper's own docstring states the workaround -- 'c.aura has no difficult= of its own ... so the workaround is to create the aura and then flip the field by hand' -- and one row already uses it. Nine rows are marked blocked while a working route sits in the tree.

c.tome_powers().why: That helper already picks 'one of the dailies a tome would have been stocked with' through c.borrow_row, walking the level ladder the card describes. Not run down: cf:wizard-arcanist-f0s4 wants c.stored_row() as well, so the symbol may be two gaps rather than one.

c.race_option().found: chargen.choices.race_options -- and it is the wrong thing
c.race_option().why: The top-ranked candidate ranks *races* for a class. f1521 needs which of five sub-options *within* a race is current, and says why c.element cannot stand in: two of the five are not damage types. The largest symbol in the queue and a genuine gap.

c.on_extra_damage().why: That helper *arms* a once-per-round rider. f1114 needs a rider's payout *announced*, so an area power can copy the amount onto its other targets. The writer exists and the event does not.

spec.stat_block().why: query.stat_block is the engine reading the compendium row behind a creature. This symbol is the authoring brief rendering a stat block. A same-name near-miss across two layers, which is the shape the ranking will keep producing.

chargen.skill_training().why: Nothing in the vocabulary comes close, and that agrees with the rows: skill training is settled when a character is built and chargen has no door for it.

c.flat(unpreventable=).why: No candidate at all. Damage that cannot be prevented or reduced has no reader anywhere.

chargen.armor_proficiency().why: No candidate. Armour proficiency is a build-time grant and chargen records none.
